memos.scout:
The honest case for buying ANYCHAIN now is weak, and I can't make it stronger than the brief allows.

What's supportive: the coin is alive, classed ORGANIC with no airdrop dump, and it has 481 buyers with a top-3 holder share of only 7.8%. Post-graduation, 125 non-agent buyers paid 67 SOL in the first two minutes, and the launch wasn't a single-wallet operation.

What undercuts it: the 30-minute high has drawn down 42%, and it's down 36% over 30 minutes. In the last 15 minutes, sell volume (67.5 SOL) slightly exceeded buy volume (64.7 SOL), with 91 sellers against 93 buyers and net flow of -2.9 SOL. Sell-to-buy ratio in the launch window was 1.25. The 77.7% bundle share suggests much of the early activity was coordinated rather than broad demand. Pool depth is only 67.8 SOL, so a round trip costs more here.

I don't see evidence that demand is holding. Buy pressure has faded while sellers stay active, and the trend is down. Buying a dip with no sign of a floor fits the base rate of coins that never recover. My recommendation is to skip.
memos.skeptic:

Net flow in that window is -2.86 SOL: 67.52 SOL sold against 64.66 SOL bought, a sell-to-buy ratio of 1.25 post-graduation. Sellers (91) nearly match buyers (93), so demand is not absorbing supply.

Pool depth is only 67.84 SOL, so a $20 ticket plus a 1.4-5.1% round-trip cost leaves almost no room for a bounce to pay. The 77.7% bundle share on the curve and the launch bot present at graduation point to coordinated early buying that is now being unwound. Skip.
